title: Student and Staff Computing Devices
bid_submission_type: Online via the iSupplier portal or manually delivered in a sealed envelope to the Dallas ISD Procurement Services Department.
term_of_bid: Initial term of 3 years with two successive one-year extensions based on the long-range needs of the District and mutual consent of both parties, not to exceed five years total.
pre_bid_meeting: June 10, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST via TEAMS video conference. Meeting ID: 270 031 467 036. Passcode: N9ndKY. Attendance is highly encouraged.
installation: White glove delivery and deployment services are required, including asset decaling, asset reporting, etching, software installation, asset tagging and etching, device deployment and setup, and asset control reporting. Etching is required on laptops. Windows devices require Autopilot enrollment and Chromebooks require Google Management enrollment.
delivery_date: Dallas ISD anticipated requesting quotes for different projects from awarded vendors starting in September 2024.

bid_summary: Dallas Independent School District is soliciting offers for student and staff computing devices under a three-year agreement with two one-year extension options, not to exceed five years total. The solicitation covers student and staff computing devices, associated deployment services, warranties, asset tagging and etching, and related vendor documentation. The submission due date was extended to July 9, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST.
product_specification: Equipment must be new and current-model OEM equipment with no substitute or aftermarket equipment. Requirements cover student Chromebooks, student Windows laptops, student tablets, staff desktops, staff laptops, and touch/non-touch monitors. Specifications include processor, display, memory, wireless connectivity, ports, storage, operating system, battery life, enterprise management, Autopilot enrollment where applicable, and minimum warranty periods. Student Chromebooks require a minimum one-year warranty; student and staff Windows laptops require a minimum three-year warranty. Warranties must be provided by the OEM. Accidental Damage Protection is not required. Etching and asset tagging are required, 65W chargers are minimum requirements for Chrome devices, and laptop battery life is based on manufacturer specifications.
